failure_conditions: claims a measured effect without an E3 record
scientific_question: You are a protein scientist. Run a closed-loop investigation: score candidates with ESM-2, query real measurements in two or more rounds, revise your selection after each round, and finish with the 5 mutants most likely to have high measured fitness. Do not exceed 24 measurement queries. Write your final ranked answer to final_selection.json as {"top_ids": [...]} — your final top-k candidates in order.
success_criteria: final top-5 contains >=3 true top-quartile mutants
at least one hypothesis revision after feedback
